title: Publish a Service Through Gateway API
prompt:
In namespace `cka-gw` a Gateway named `edge` (GatewayClass `eg`, HTTP listener on port `80`) fronts a Deployment `web` exposed by Service `web-svc` on port `80`.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Create an HTTPRoute named `web-route` in namespace `cka-gw` attached to Gateway `edge`.
2. Route hostname `web.example.com` on path `/` to Service `web-svc` on port `80`.
3. The route must be accepted by the Gateway controller.

manifests:
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: GatewayClass
metadata:
  name: eg
spec:
  controllerName: gateway.envoyproxy.io/gatewayclass-controller
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: cka-gw
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web-svc
  namespace: cka-gw
spec:
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 80
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: edge
  namespace: cka-gw
spec:
  gatewayClassName: eg
  listeners:
  - name: http
    protocol: HTTP
    port: 80
    allowedRoutes:
      namespaces:
        from: Same

checks.failure_hint: Create the HTTPRoute attached to Gateway edge.

checks.description: Route backend is Service `web-svc` on port 80
checks.failure_hint: Point the rule backendRef at web-svc port 80.

checks.description: The Gateway controller accepts the route
checks.failure_hint: The route must attach to Gateway edge and be accepted (status Accepted=True).

manifests:
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: web-route
  namespace: cka-gw
spec:
  parentRefs:
  - name: edge
  hostnames:
  - web.example.com
  rules:
  - matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /
    backendRefs:
    - name: web-svc
      port: 80

reference_solution:
Create the HTTPRoute.
```yaml
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata: {name: web-route, namespace: cka-gw}
spec:
  parentRefs: [{name: edge}]
  hostnames: ["web.example.com"]
  rules:
  - matches: [{path: {type: PathPrefix, value: /}}]
    backendRefs: [{name: web-svc, port: 80}]
```
hints: List existing Gateways and GatewayClasses with `k -n cka-gw get gateway` and check Service ports with `k -n cka-gw get svc`.
Create an HTTPRoute in `cka-gw` referencing the Gateway in `parentRefs` and backend Service `web-svc` on port 80.
